result.title: RaReCache: Bridging the Gap in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse via Rank disagreement-based Selective Recomputation
result.summary: Cross-model KV-cache reuse remains a key challenge in modern LLM serving. Coding agents and multi-model systems increasingly route a shared context across models: a user may switch models mid-session, or a cascade may escalate a difficult query. Because KV caches contain model-specific representations, each switch typically forces the receiving model to prefill the entire context from scratch. Recent work shows that closed-form linear maps can translate KV caches between models in the same family, but transfer accuracy degrades as the model-size gap widens. In this paper, we establish that these transfer failures are concentrated in a small subset of information-dense tokens. To bridge this gap, we introduce RaReCache, a framework that enables a large target model to decode accurately from a cache prefilled by a much smaller source via selective recomputation. RaReCache identifies these critical positions using a novel rank disagreement metric, scoring each token by the energy of its mapped KV in output directions weakly supported by the calibration data. Across two model families and five benchmarks, on a 23x parameter gap (Qwen3-0.6B to 14B) recomputing just 30% of positions retains 95-99% of the target accuracy, whereas on a 8.8x gap (Llama3-8B to 70B), recomputing 40% retains 96.5% of the target accuracy. RaReCache largely removes sensitivity to source-model size, and achieves up to a 3.04x prefill speedup. For online serving, it handles 1.8x the request throughput of target prefill on a single GPU, and at the target's saturation load, reduces median and 99th-percentile time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 5.0x and 6.4x respectively, with a 30% recompute budget. RaReCache establishes an efficient serving paradigm where small models prefill on behalf of massive targets, enabling large models to recompute only critical tokens, drastically reducing prefill latency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RaReCache：在跨模型 KV cache 复用场景下，用 rank disagreement 度量把线性映射后的 KV 在标定数据支持较弱的输出方向上的能量作为打分，识别少数信息密集的关键 token 并只对这些位置做选择性重算。实验在 Qwen3 与 Llama3 两个模型族、五个基准上以 30%–40% 重算预算保留 95%–99% 目标模型精度，并报告最高 3.04x prefill 加速与 TTFT 改善。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以方向能量打分定位信息密集位置、只刷新关键 token」的思路，可能可供核查用于 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 位置重要性判断与状态部分刷新；但原文面向纯文本 serving 效率而非多模态推理，迁移可行性需进一步确认。
